title: Scaling Graph Reasoning in Language Models with Learnable Graph Positional Encodings
abstract: arXiv:2610.27439v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Solving reasoning tasks supported on graphs typically requires providing a Language Reasoning Model (LRM) with a serialized description of the graph. This approach results in the input length growing with the number of edges, which limits the size of the problems that can be solved. Furthermore, even when graphs fit in context, performance sharply decays as the graphs grow. We propose to address this by augmenting LRMs with scalable and permutation equivariant graph positional encodings that modulate attention logits. An additional post-fusion-style module incorporates structural information into hidden states. We compute these positional encodings using a GNN followed by a Graph Transformer. This eliminates the need for serialized adjacencies, reducing the context burden to $O(N)$. translated_title: 使用可学习的图位置编码扩展语言模型中的图推理能力
translated_abstract: 解决基于图的推理任务通常需要向语言推理模型提供图的序列化描述。这种方法导致输入长度随边数增长，从而限制了可解决问题的规模。此外，即使图能够适应上下文窗口，随着图规模的增大，性能也会急剧下降。我们提出通过为语言推理模型添加可扩展且置换等变的图位置编码来解决这一问题，这些位置编码可以调制注意力逻辑值。一个额外的后融合式模块将结构信息融入隐藏状态。我们使用图神经网络（GNN）和图Transformer来计算这些位置编码，从而消除了对序列化邻接关系的需求，将上下文负担降低到O(N)。我们使用图论求解器生成的最优解，联合微调位置编码器和语言推理模型的LoRA适配器，从而在计算上……
tldr: 该论文提出用GNN与图Transformer计算的可学习图位置编码直接调制语言模型的注意力，并以后融合模块注入结构信息，从而无需序列化图描述、将上下文负担降至O(N)，显著扩展了语言模型可处理的图推理问题规模。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes learnable graph positional encodings computed via a GNN and Graph Transformer to modulate language model attention, combined with a post-fusion module, eliminating serialized graph descriptions, reducing context burden to O(N), and enabling scalable graph reasoning on larger graphs.
